ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure, with an R group on the left connected to the left-side carbon; the left-side carbon is also connected to the upper O, and connected to the middle carbon. The middle carbon has a vertical connection to the upper O, and connects to the right to a side-chain carbon; the end of the right-side side chain is connected to an O marked with a negative sign. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: According to the specified method, count only visible bonds between non-hydrogen atoms and exclude arrows. Six bonds can be listed: R–left-side carbon, left-side carbon–upper O, left-side carbon–middle carbon, middle carbon–upper O, middle carbon–right-side side-chain carbon, and right-side side-chain carbon–terminal O. Therefore the total number of bonds is 6.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: List every visible atom-to-atom bond that is not to hydrogen and is not an arrow: R–left carbon, left carbon–top O, left carbon–central carbon, central carbon–top O, central carbon–right carbon in the side chain, and right carbon–terminal O. Count these six entries to obtain the total number of bonds.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有一个 R 基团连接到左侧碳；左侧碳还与上方的 O 相连，并与中间的碳相连。中间碳与上方的 O 有一条竖直连接，并向右连接到侧链碳；右侧侧链末端连接一个带负号标记的 O。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按指定方法只数非氢原子之间的可见键，并排除箭头。可列出 6 个键：R–左侧碳、左侧碳–上方 O、左侧碳–中间碳、中间碳–上方 O、中间碳–右侧侧链碳、右侧侧链碳–末端 O。因此总键数为 6。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the most direct visual-inventory route: it treats each visible non-arrow bond stroke as a countable bond and totals them without reinterpreting the structure as a formal molecular graph.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a line-bond drawing: note the R group at upper left, the small three-membered cyclic/transition-state portion containing an O at the top, the bold/solid C-C connection on the left, the vertical C-O bond, the side chain extending right, and the terminal O⁻; ignore the curved arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Apply the prompt instructions to include all single/double/triple bonds if present, exclude bonds involving hydrogen, disregard arrows, and consider all components in the transition-state structure.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the convention that each line segment between two non-hydrogen atoms is one bond for this question; a bold wedge/solid bond still counts as one bond, and curved arrows are electron-flow notation rather than bonds.

method.method_draft: Build the heavy-atom adjacency list from the image. The left ring carbon is adjacent to R, the top O, and the lower/central carbon; the lower/central carbon is adjacent to the top O and to the right side-chain carbon; the right side-chain carbon is adjacent to the terminal O⁻. Counting the unique adjacency edges gives 6 bonds.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，包含左侧的 R 基团、一个左侧环碳、上方的 O、下方/中央的碳、右侧侧链碳以及末端的 O⁻；图中还有弯箭头和箭头标记，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按重原子邻接关系计数，不包括氢相关键。左侧环碳与 R、上方 O、下方/中央碳相连，共 3 条键；下方/中央碳还与上方 O 和右侧侧链碳相连，其中与左侧环碳的连接已计过，因此新增 2 条键；右侧侧链碳与末端 O⁻ 相连，新增 1 条键。唯一重原子键总数为 3 + 2 + 1 = 6。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route is weakly distinct from direct stroke counting because it first converts the drawing into a heavy-atom connectivity graph/adjacency list and then counts graph edges, which helps avoid accidentally counting arrows or atom labels as bonds.
planner_metadata.image_role: Identify the heavy-atom nodes shown in the drawing: the R substituent label, the left ring carbon, the top oxygen, the lower/central ring carbon, the right side-chain carbon, and the terminal negatively charged oxygen; observe which pairs are connected by drawn bond lines.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to set the counting rule: count all bonds among non-hydrogen atoms across the whole depicted transition-state structure, but do not count hydrogen bonds or the curved arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use molecular graph reasoning: bonds correspond to edges between heavy-atom nodes, and the total bond count is the number of unique edges in the adjacency list; transition-state arrows and charges do not add graph edges.
